book.title: PILIPAI Poloto Pilipai Tane Tupana Pepa Peyo Pee Leane Oko

content: Akali Koo Tupamane Yakama Minu Koyolaini, Waiwa Ando Atalapape Leane Oko

Amene imalini yame, yakamato Akali Andane oko nembo toto, epelewa atalapape. Wamba nambato pii minditupa pepa peyo epe lewa tekeko, pii okonemane yakama moyolo-peya nembo toto, andipa namba kepa naene, pii mindiki okone teke dee lapone pepa peyo epe loto, wua leyo:

Gotena Oli Sipitisa oko nanimanga eya-kola, nanimato Gote lo lotu loto, Jisasa Kataisana gene oko laiyu lalamane. Nanimato wuane piyamane okonena, Gotena wenonga nanima yala-pene umbaini katene gulo atalamane. Umbaini katene gulo ateyama-kola, akali mindimane nanimana yala-pene umbaini oko kateaindo, mana okone bala mee umbaini kenga yoto, nanima katulo moya napulu-peyako. Peango anatope gulene akali tupamane mana koo mindi minuto, Pilipai tane akali yakamana yala-pene umbaini oko katiyapa lalaini okomane yakamana bilipi oko minu koyolaini. Waiwa ando atalapape.

Wandakali minditupa-mane kopeta nembo toto, Goteto wandakalina umbaini kenga mana okonepene tupa andoto, utupane yapa lo tale pulupeya nembo talaini tekeko, Goteto wandakalina umbaini kenga mana tupa andoto, utupane yapa lo tale piyae pia-yale, balato namba Polona gene oko laiyu loto, namba akali waka tupa sia minuto, akali epene tika-pene wete ateya lapia-yale nembo teyo.

Namba angini-mane namba mandu yatawa pituto, ole yanasa pea-kola, ole kitupane okona nambana yala-pene umbaini oko kateainipia. Namba Benjamene yame atoto, namba Isatale tane mindi ateyo. Nambana yumbane yame tupa pitaka Iputu yame angu ateainipia. Namba akali Patasai mindi atoto, Patasai yamena mana wato minuto, Juta yamena loo yene tupa pitaka kuai lo wete wato minu atewane.

Nambato Juta yamena loo yene tupa kuai lo wete wato minu atewa-kola, wandakali mindimane katulo nambanga koo tene mindi yata nayaini. Jia. Nambato Gotena piape oko tika pua peyo nembo toto, kenda-pene andane tupa sosa okona wandakali tupanga maiki pua atewane.

Wamba nambato mana utupane nembo toto, nambato akali waka tupa sia minuto, akali epene tika-pene wete ateyo nembo tewa tekeko, andipa nambato piape Kataisato peane tupa nembo toto, namba tane mana wamba minu atewa utupane pitaka angini mindi jia ya lo nembo teyo.

Jisasa Kataisa bala nambana Akali Andane oko atoto, namba wayumane wete moyalane lo nayuto, bala towa atauwa lakae lo nembo teyo. Wuane nembo toto, nambato minditaka waka taka eya tupa pitaka angini mindi jia ya lo nembo toto, utupane masia mawua ateyo.

Nambato Kataisa angu nemboto minatawa atama pulu, omolawa-kola, matili Goteto namba malinga ika laya yakale nembo teyo. Wuane nembo toto, wamba Kataisa bala tandaka nalu omeane wuane pua teke, nambapi tandaka nalu omokale. Omolowa-kola, Goteto Kataisa bala malinga ika laya yane pua teke, balato nambapi malinga ika laya ola-angi, nambato balana tai-lene oko andokale nembo teyo. Wuane pukale nembo toto, nambato Gotena loo tupa pitaka wato minu atolowa mana okonemane namba akali epene tika-pene gulolo-peyo nembo nateyo. Jia. Nambato Kataisa bilipi lo atolowa-kola, Goteto namba akali epene tika-pene ateya lolopeya nembo toto, nambato Kataisa towa mina mindiki lo atokale.
Yakamato Nambana Mana Oko Wato Minalapape Leane Oko

Nambato Kataisana mana epene tika-pene tupa pitaka mia yiake loto, namba akali epene tika-pene gulo ateyo naleyo. Jia. Namba Jisasa Kataisana yame atola lo balato namba minea-kola, nambato balana mana epene tika-pene tupa wato minu atokale nembo toto, piape tailo pua ateyo.

Amene imalini yame, nambato Kataisana mana tupa kuai lo wato minalawane naleyo tekeko, nambato mangene wamba pewane tupa embesa wato, mangene matili pukale tupa nembo tatawa atoto, piape tailo pua ateyo.

Jisasa Kataisato namba moyo piape peane mambele, Goteto namba ati kenga yuu epene okona epola loto, ee lo meane. Balato wuane peane okonena, nambato ati kenga pataisa epene eya okone mokale nembo toto, maki okonena peakaiyu loyale asia tai leyo.
Kitisene tai atalamane wandakali nanima pitaka wuane teke pimakale nemboto atamakale. Yakamato nembo-tene waka mindi palu ateaindo, Goteto okone yakama andawa lolopeya.
Goteto wuane pulupeya nembo toto, andipa nanimato Kitisene mana epene wamba mema tupa wato minu atamakale.

Amene imalini yame, wamba ole kambuanga nambato pii yakama langewa okone teke andipapi namba ai lo atoto, dee lapone teke yakama langulu-peke leyo. Wandakali kambua-mane yuu okona minditaka eya tupa angu nembo toto, mana yala-pene tupa minu atoto, yakama tanena gene tupa laiyu lalaini. Wandakali utupane-mane yakamana umbainina epele ene tupa yakamana gote gulo minu atoto, Kataisana ita malamanda oko towa yanda-pene gulo atalaini. Wuane piyaini wandakali utupane yakama yuu koo ita too atapowa atene okona alu pulupeyai. Pilipai tane wandakali yakamato mana koo okonepene tupa wato mina na-piyapale nembo toto, nanimato mana epene minditupa yakama andawa loto, yakamato wua pua atalapape lema-kola, wandakali minditupa-mane mana epene utupane wato mineai. Yakamato wandakali utupanena mana epene utupane wayumane andoto, nambana mana epene utupane wato minu atalapape.
Ati kenga yuu epene oko nanimana yuu tene oko eya. Matili Akali Andane Jisasa Kataisa bala ati kenga yuu epene okone tepa alu, nanima lamolo epolopeya lo maliyo ateyama.

Bala epola-angi, balana tai-lene okomane balato minditaka eya tupa pitaka balana pangosa yakale lolopeya. Wuane loto, balana tai-lene okomane nanimana umbaini tai nalene ateya tupa mo lawua puato, bala tanena umbaini epene wete ateya okonepene teke gulaya olopeya.
